objectives: The objective of the current course is to advance course attendants’ understanding of personnel recruitment and selection. This course is designed to help executive students to learn important recruitment and selection theories and realize the practices. The major course challenge will be integrating what you have known about HR in the past and can apply HR theory and recent research findings to diagnose and solve practical problems and challenges.
content:
1/2      Introduction to Recruitment ＆ Selection

3.        Strategic Recruiting ＆ the Targets

4.        Recruitment Source

5/6      Employer branding ＆ CSR

7.        Digital recruiting ＆ Social media

8.        IVEY Case Discussion

9.        Reliability and Validity (I)

10.      Reliability and Validity (II): Application of HR analytics

11.      Biodata

12.      Personality test

13.      Selection Interview

14.      Applicant Reaction

15/16  自主學習週

17/18  Final Exams ＆ Final Report
books:
Judge, T. A., ＆ Kammeryer-Muller, J. (2021) Staffing Organizations. 10th edition
Gatewood, Field, ＆ Barrick (2015). Human Resource Selection. 8th Eds, South-Western College Publication.
